title: The Human Digestive System
text: The digestive system breaks down food into nutrients the body can absorb and use for energy, growth, and repair. Digestion begins in the mouth with chewing and saliva, continues in the stomach with acid and enzymes, and proceeds through the small intestine, where most nutrient absorption occurs. The large intestine absorbs water and forms waste. Organs including the liver and pancreas contribute digestive enzymes and bile.
